name: Ela (Edomite chieftain, descendant of Esau)
title: Edomite chieftain
summary: Ela was one of the chieftains (tribal princes) in Edom, listed as a descendant of Esau. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the Edomite chieftains who ruled in Esau's land, Seir. His role testifies to the development of Esau's descendants into organized tribal principalities in the region of Edom.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of Esau
keyEvents.description: Ela is listed as a son of Esau and as a chief in Edom in the genealogy of Esau's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Chiefs of Edom
keyEvents.description: Ela is counted among the Edomite chiefs who descended from Esau's son Eliphaz and ruled over Esau's land.

keyEvents.title: Esau Settles in Seir
keyEvents.description: Esau settled in the hill country of Seir, and his descendants, including Ela, became tribal leaders in this area.

keyEvents.title: Repetition in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Ela's name is repeated in the genealogy of Edom's chiefs in the book of Chronicles as part of the extensive overview of the lineages of Israel and neighboring nations.

keyEvents.title: The Chiefs of Edom by Regions
keyEvents.description: Ela is mentioned among the chiefs who are named after their clans and settlements in the land of Edom.
